newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ibiden rises after strong rating.
newsitem.headline: Ibiden rises after strong rating.

text.p: Shares in Ibiden Co Ltd rose on Wednesday after a brokerage assigned a strong rating to the firm, brokers said.
At 0358 GMT, the electrical machinery maker's shares were up 50 yen at 1,130 yen on turnover of 1.717 million shares, ranking fourth on the top percentage gainers list.
Nikko Research Center Ltd assigned a "1" rating to Ibiden, Nikko brokers said.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
